root_facts: Client terms, fixed clock, contract-completion command and idempotency identity.
Exact bank receipt and later reversal roots, assignment intents and actual-start confirmation.
Cancellation command plus the official service-day roots that exist at that instant.
forbidden_direct_seed: orders.status, end_date, actual_end_date or lifecycle version
client receivable summaries, payroll projections or service-day projections
order history, locking state, outbox or lifecycle receipts
commands: Preview and Apply terms, then complete the contract once and replay the identical command.
Reconcile the exact deposit, confirm actual start, and project official service days.
Exercise cancellation, reopen guards, pre-service reversal, in-service reversal and completion locking.
expected: Preview has zero write delta; Apply creates one coherent formal transaction and replay returns its receipt.
Every lifecycle transition is derived from roots and guards; caller-supplied target status is rejected.
Cancellation after full service, stale confirmation and invalid reopen leave state and row deltas unchanged.
API and UI expose negotiation, established, active, completed, cancelled and locked states without hidden mutation.
